measurement_basis: Two protected Environment claim attempts exposed first-non-option session binding; the failure was isolated to option-value parsing and captured as an RPC regression case.
not_measured: frequency of this argument ordering across other agents and commands
whether different CLI clients produce the same failure
resource overhead attributable to session parsing

request.argument_order: repository and claim options precede the positional session identity

outcome.error: Environment session is not present in canonical Store
outcome.interpretation: Control treated the repository option value as the selected session because it chose the first non-option token without skipping option values.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Control misbinds Environment sessions when options precede the positional identity
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Parse the documented CLI argument grammar, skip option values, and bind mutations to the exact session selected by the authenticated continuation.

related_work.campaign_objective: Implement MNCS environmental capability intelligence: connect authentic agent-session, diagnostics, resource, and compiler evidence to provenance-aware queryable projections that reveal actionable recurring environmental pressures, then verify and improve the observation-to-action loop.
related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
